guitar.guitaristsText: Keith Richards / Ronnie Wood / Mick Taylor
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster ('Micawber', 5-string open-G) / Gibson Les Paul / ES series
guitar.evidence: Keith Richards' 5-string open-G-tuned Telecaster 'Micawber' is one of the most famous specific guitars in rock history; this justifies high rather than medium confidence.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high due to Richards' very specifically documented guitar/tuning setup.

tone.target: distorted female-vocal lead with dirty fuzz edge
tone.profile: distorted female-vocal lead with dirty fuzz edge
tone.summary: A fuzzy, aggressive signal chain using Fuzz/Distortion into a British amp model (UK 45 or UK 50) with minimal clean effects to maintain grit and bite.

rig.name: The Rolling Stones - Gimme Shelter - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a raw signal edge.
Provide initial grit and mid-range bite before the main fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here to simulate a dirty, raw boost/overdrive character rather than pure clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core fuzzy sustain and dark texture required for the song's atmosphere.
Optional filter sweep for added texture (kept inactive to maintain raw sound).
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is generally used for funk/rock, but its ability to shape the mid-range can add grit without sounding too clean.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a cranked British combo amp for raw power and mid-range punch.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound to complement the UK 45 amp model.
Slightly boost the mid-range frequencies to enhance 'raw mid bite' and cut through the mix.
Add a subtle, dark ambient space without the warmth or length of traditional reverb.
blocks.gap: The 'Room' setting is chosen over Plate/Spring to provide a natural, non-washy ambience that supports the gritty texture.

blocks.purpose: Final output level control to ensure the fuzzy signal is audible and aggressive.

improvements.summary: Replace the default cabinet IR with a darker, more aggressive British speaker to enhance the raw mid-range bite and dark texture.

proposals.recommendedAsset: dark/dirty 4x12 IR (e.g., dirty tweed or old tube)
proposals.reason: Enhance the raw, gritty mid-range and dark texture required for 'Gimme Shelter'.
